children.text: This raw footage is an interview with Dr. Américo Paredes' brother, Lorenzo Paredes. Paredes talks about Américo and his other brothers, as he and Dr. Manuel F. Medrano look through a photo album and a book of poetry. Paredes also discusses his life, education, and work in Brownsville, Texas. The interview finishes with Paredes talking about his family history.
